app.name: Cleanup: Phone Storage Cleaner
app.description: A phone storage cleaner utility that helps remove duplicate photos, compress videos, merge duplicate contacts, and clean spam emails to free up iPhone storage.

verdict.one_liner: Cleanup processes your photos on-device, but aggressively shares device and advertising data with multiple ad partners for personalized tracking.
verdict.summary: Cleanup is a storage cleaner utility that promises to process photos, contacts, and emails locally without uploading them to company servers. However, it collects extensive device information and advertising identifiers (IDFA, GAID) and shares them with Google, Facebook, Apple, Adjust, and Firebase Analytics for personalized advertising. The app also requests broad permissions including full access to your photo library, contacts, and even email read/send/delete capabilities. While the local-processing claim is a genuine privacy positive, the extensive ad tracking and broad permission requirements drag the score down to a C.
verdict.recommendation_reason: The app offers useful storage cleaning features and genuinely processes sensitive data like photos on your device rather than uploading them. However, it embeds multiple advertising and analytics SDKs, shares your advertising identifiers for personalized ads, and requests very broad permissions including full email access. If you use it, deny marketing consent when prompted and only grant the minimum permissions you need.

red.title: Shares ad IDs with multiple tracking partners
red.plain_english: The app collects your advertising ID (IDFA, GAID) and shares it with Google, Facebook, Apple, Adjust, and Firebase Analytics to show you personalized ads and run marketing analysis.

red.title: Scans your entire photo library
red.plain_english: To find duplicate and similar photos, the app requests broad access to your entire photo gallery rather than letting you pick individual photos.

red.title: Can read, compose, send, and delete your emails
red.plain_english: If you enable the email cleaning feature, the app gets permission to fully manage your emails including reading contents, composing new emails, and deleting messages.

red.title: Collects detailed device fingerprint
red.plain_english: The app gathers your device name, model, manufacturer, operating system, unique device identifiers, hardware model, and region info, which together create a detailed fingerprint of your device.

red.title: Data transferred to servers abroad
red.plain_english: Your personal data is sent to servers and cloud providers located outside your country, including for storage and advertising services.

green.title: Photos and contacts stay on your device
green.plain_english: The company explicitly states it does not store your photos, videos, or contacts on its own servers. Processing happens on your device or within your personal cloud services only.

green.title: Sensitive permissions are optional
green.plain_english: You can deny access to your contacts, photos, and email account, though this will limit which features you can use.

green.title: Never handles your payment card details
green.plain_english: The app does not collect or store your credit card information. All payments are processed by third-party payment providers like Paddle.

green.title: Offers data deletion and export rights
green.plain_english: You can request deletion of your personal data, and the policy outlines specific rights for users in Europe and California.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The app does not access your camera or microphone. It only reads existing photos and videos from your device's gallery.
categories.detail: The privacy policy mentions photos and videos only as user content uploaded or transmitted to the app. There is no mention of in-app camera or microphone access.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: The app does not track your precise GPS location. It may estimate your general area based on your IP address or device region settings.
categories.detail: The policy states the company may determine the general area of the device's location based on IP address and region information. No GPS or precise location tracking is mentioned.
categories.policy_excerpt: Please note that we may be able to determine the general area of your device's location when it interacts with our Services, based on the information associated with your IP address and the region information of the device.
concerns: IP address used for approximate location inference

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: The app can access your full contacts list if you allow it, for example to merge duplicate contacts. The company says it does not upload or store your contacts on its servers.
categories.detail: The app asks permission to access the contact application and full contact list. The policy explicitly states contact list data is not stored on company servers and processing occurs on the device or user's own cloud services.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may ask for your permission to access your contact application (thereby the full contact list)... Please note that we do not store any of your contact list... on our servers; activities to process these will be carried out on your device or your own cloud services only.
concerns: Purpose unclear beyond contact merging feature

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: The app needs broad access to your entire photo library to scan for duplicate and similar photos. While the company says it does not upload photos to its servers, the permission scope is very wide.
categories.detail: As a storage cleaner, the app requests access to the device's photo file or gallery app and preferred cloud services to find similar photos, duplicates, and screenshots. The policy claims photos are not stored on company servers and processing is done locally.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may ask for your permission to access your device's photo file or gallery app or your preferred cloud services in order to provide our services, such as to generate output for photos you share (e.g., determining similar photos in your gallery).
concerns: Broad library access required for core functionality

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Your marketing and advertising data is shared with Google, Facebook, Apple, Adjust, and Firebase Analytics for personalized ads and marketing analysis. The company says it does not sell data for money, but sharing for ad targeting still happens.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly states Marketing Data is transferred to service providers including Google, Apple, Facebook SDK, Adjust, and Firebase Analytics embedded into the service for advertising and marketing analysis. The California disclosure notes this sharing may be considered a 'sale' under state law.
categories.policy_excerpt: The Company may also transfer your Marketing Data to service providers (incl. Google, Apple, Facebook SDK, Adjust and Firebase Analytics, which are embedded into our service) for the purpose of conducting marketing analysis studies and execution of advertising (including personalised advertising)/campaign/promotion processes.
concerns: Marketing data shared with multiple advertising networks
California law may classify this as a 'sale' of personal information

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: The app collects standard account information like your name, email, and phone number when you contact them or create an account. If you connect your email, it also gets your Google user ID and profile details.
categories.detail: Identity and Contact Information includes name, surname, phone number, and email address. For email integration, Google user ID, nickname, username, profile picture, phone number, and email address are collected. This is used for account management and service delivery.
categories.policy_excerpt: your name and surname, e-mail address and phone number which we may receive if you contact the Company... Google user ID, nickname, username, profile picture, user token, Open ID, phone number, e-mail address
concerns: Email account integration links additional identity data

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: The app collects your advertising identifiers (IDFA, GAID) and usage data to show you personalized ads and analyze marketing performance. This tracking happens continuously while you use the app.
categories.detail: Marketing Data includes Usage Data, IDFA, IDFV, GAID, and Firebase analytics identifier. This data is collected with explicit consent where required and used for personalized advertising and marketing analysis. The California section notes analytics and advertising tools may be considered 'sale' or 'sharing' of personal information.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you give us permission, we may collect your Usage Data; and an identifier for advertisers designated in your mobile device used in accessing our services (the Identifier for Advertisers-IDFA), an identifier for vendors/developers designated to your mobile device (the Identifier for Vendors-IDFV), Google advertising ID (GAID); identifier for Firebase analytics.
concerns: Personalized advertising based on user behavior
Analytics data shared with third parties

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: The app says it is not for children under 16, and users under 18 need parental permission. However, the policy does not explain how it actually checks or enforces these age limits.
categories.detail: The policy states the application is not permitted for use by children under 16 and that users under 18 must have permission from parents or legal guardians. No technical enforcement mechanism is described.
categories.policy_excerpt: We do not permit the use of our application by children under the age of 16. Users under 18 must have permission from their parents or legal guardians to use our Services.
concerns: No enforcement mechanism described for age limit

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: The app logs your IP address, internet traffic data, and how you interact with the service. Your IP address may be used to estimate your general location.
categories.detail: Log Data includes internet traffic data, network movements, IP address, browser type, and usage statistics. The policy notes IP address and region information may be used to determine the general area of the device's location.
categories.policy_excerpt: This log data includes internet traffic data, network movements, Internet Protocol ('IP') address, device name, device information, operating system version, visit data, browser type, version and settings, language preference, time zone, information about your use of Services...
concerns: IP address collected and used for location inference

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: The app collects extensive details about your device including its name, model, manufacturer, operating system, unique device identifiers, and hardware model. Combined with advertising IDs, this creates a detailed fingerprint used for ad targeting.
categories.detail: Device Information collected includes device name, device ID, model, manufacturer, region information, operating system, device identifiers, and hardware model. These are collected alongside advertising identifiers and used for analytics and personalized advertising.
categories.policy_excerpt: Device Information: We may collect data about the device you use to interact with our Services, including the device name, device ID, its model, its manufacturer, region information, device's operating system, device identifiers, hardware model.
concerns: Device data used for advertising and analytics

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The app does not collect or process any health or biometric data. The company explicitly states it does not handle sensitive personal data.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly states the company does not process any sensitive personal data and asks users not to share content containing sensitive personal data.
categories.policy_excerpt: No, we do not process any sensitive personal data. Please do not share with us any content that might have any sensitive personal data.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: The app does not collect your credit card details. If you make a purchase, payment is handled by third-party processors like Paddle. The app only sees order information like subscription type and billing status.
categories.detail: Customer Transaction information includes order date, payment date, subscription type, billing period, billing document, payment amount, due amount, payment status, and transaction identifiers. The policy explicitly states payment method details such as credit card numbers are not collected because the company does not directly process payments.
categories.policy_excerpt: Please note that we do not collect your payment method details, such as your credit card number, as we do not directly process your payment.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can request deletion of your personal data by emailing the company. However, some data may be kept longer for legal obligations, backup purposes, or to protect the company's legal rights.
categories.detail: The policy outlines deletion rights under Turkish PDP Law and GDPR. Requests are handled within 30 days and are free of charge. However, data may be retained for legal limitation periods, backup safety windows, and legal rights establishment even after deletion requests.
categories.policy_excerpt: Request deletion, destruction or anonymization of personal data if the reasons for the processing have disappeared... Our Company will finalize your requests, free of charge, within 30 (thirty) days at the latest... your data may be further stored even after the fulfilment of the purpose of processing on the legal basis of the necessity of the establishment, execution and protection of our legal rights until the end of legal limitation periods.
concerns: Data retention continues for legal limitation periods
Some data retained for backup and legal rights protection

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: The company will update the date at the top of the policy when changes are made. For major changes, they say they will show a notice in the app or send an email. But simply continuing to use the app after changes counts as accepting them.
categories.detail: Material changes are communicated via app interface pop-up, email, or other reasonable means. However, continued use of the Services after the effective date constitutes acknowledgment of updated terms unless explicit consent is required by law.
categories.policy_excerpt: If we make material changes... we will provide you with prominent notice before the changes take effect. This notice may be provided through the Application interface (e.g., a pop-up notification), by sending an email... Your continued use of the Services after the effective date of any revised Privacy Policy constitutes your acknowledgment of the updated terms...
concerns: Continued use equals acceptance of policy changes
